comment: Models and reference binaries for `conformance bench` (crates/conformance/README.md, "Benchmarks"). The models are the engine milestone audit's (docs/audits/engine-milestone.md). `file` paths start with {REF} (the OpenSCAD reference checkout) or {BOSL2} (.reference/BOSL2); `source` is the model itself; `inputs` are files a model imports, generated by neoscad from the given source as ASCII STL before the first run. A model whose `requires` library is missing is skipped with a note. `references` run in this order; `quick` marks the ones `--quick` runs, `eval` the ones the evaluation-only metric runs (the backend makes no difference there).

cold_start.description: cube(1); exported to ASCII STL: process start-up plus the smallest render

eval_only.description: BOSL2's test suite (tests/*.scadtest, one process per test, run one after another) exported to .echo: evaluation only, no geometry

edit_loop.description: The agent's edit loop: a one-line edit, then a re-render or a snapshot. `serve`: neoscad serve on stdio driven over JSON-RPC (update + render, update + snapshot); `cli_via_serve`: the edited file on disk, then `neoscad FILE -o out.stl` / `neoscad snapshot FILE` as clients of `neoscad serve --socket`; `cli_cold`: the same with no server; `nightly_cold`: the nightly exporting STL and a 1024x1024 --render PNG. Every edit gives the edited line a new value, so the geometry cache never answers a whole model. Best and median of `runs` edits, in ms.

bosl2.description: A BOSL2 part: rounded cuboid, chamfered cylinder and prismoid; the edit changes the cuboid's height

csg.description: OpenSCAD's examples/Basics/CSG.scad; the edit moves the difference (the third object)

bosl_gears__003.description: BOSL2 gears.scad doc example 3: helical spur_gear
bosl_gears__003.source:
include <BOSL2/std.scad>
include <BOSL2/gears.scad>
spur_gear(
    circ_pitch=5, teeth=20, thickness=10,
    shaft_diam=5, helical=-30, slices=12,
    $fa=1, $fs=1
);
